disagreements.item: Order of Fighting Energy attachment and Buneary -> Mega Lopunny ex evolution
disagreements.C: Fighting Energy attached to Buneary first (~86-89 s), then evolved into Mega Lopunny ex (~90-91 s)
disagreements.X: Evolved Buneary into Mega Lopunny ex first (90-92 s), then attached the Fighting Energy (93-94 s)
disagreements.frames_show: At 87 s and 89 s Buneary has no Energy and the Fighting Energy is still in the Energy Zone. At 92 s Mega Lopunny ex 190 is already in play and the Energy is still in the Zone. At 94 s the Zone is empty and Mega Lopunny ex has 1 Fighting Energy. So it evolved first and the Energy went on afterwards.

disagreements.C: 3 cards: Poké Ball, Mega Gyarados ex, Magikarp (revealed 170-172 s)
disagreements.X: New hand includes Mega Gyarados ex, two Poké Balls and Magikarp
disagreements.frames_show: The drawn cards are revealed one at a time: Poké Ball (170 s) and Mega Gyarados ex (171.5 s). The hand at 173 s is exactly 3 cards: Poké Ball, Mega Gyarados ex, Magikarp. There is no second Poké Ball.

disagreements.item: Poké Ball plays and their effect
disagreements.C: One Poké Ball, played ~174-178 s, with no effect ('There are no cards in the deck that can be the target of the effect'). Magikarp came from Copycat.
disagreements.X: First Poké Ball at 170 s got Magikarp. A second Poké Ball (174-178 s) found nothing.
disagreements.frames_show: Magikarp is already in hand at 173 s, before any Poké Ball is played. At 177 s the no-target message shows and the hand is Mega Gyarados ex + Magikarp. At 180 s only one Poké Ball is in the discard. The 170 s Poké Ball image is the Copycat reveal, not a play.

disagreements.item: When and to what the Fighting Energy went on Hitmonchan ex (order versus X Speed and retreat)
disagreements.C: X Speed, then the retreat (Hitmonchan ex Active), then Fighting Energy attached to the Active Hitmonchan ex (~222-225 s)
disagreements.X: Fighting attached to the benched Hitmonchan ex at 212-213 s, before X Speed (215 s) and the retreat
disagreements.frames_show: At 212 s and 214 s the benched Hitmonchan ex has no Energy and the Fighting Energy is still in the Zone. At 222 s X Speed is in the discard, Hitmonchan ex is Active with no Energy, and the Energy is still in the Zone. At 225 s the Energy is on the Active Hitmonchan ex and the Zone is empty.

disagreements.item: Final-turn Turbo Shark bench Energy and Mega Gyarados ex's final Energy count
disagreements.C: Turbo Shark attached a 4th Water to the benched Mega Gyarados ex (4 icons at 346 s)
disagreements.X: Final bench Mega Gyarados ex has three Water. The terminal attack does not establish any further Turbo Shark attachment.
disagreements.frames_show: Mega Gyarados ex has 3 Water at 337 s and 4 Water at 346 s, after the KO and before the game ends.
